question.text: The lines joining the origin to the points of intersection of the line <math><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>24</mn></math> with the circle <math><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>25</mn></math> are

solution.text:
Let the line intersects the circle at points A & B

Nw, the given line AB is a diameter as it passes through centre 3,4.

O0,0 is a point on the circle as 9+16=25.

∴∠AOB=π2 as angle in a semi-circle is π2
∴OA is perpendicular to OB.
